title: Workplace Program Detector
description: A company domain in, the people programs that company publishes out.

domain.title: Company domain
domain.description: Bare domain, for example hubspot.com. Protocol and path are stripped.

programs.title: Programs To Report
programs.description: Report only these program families. Leave empty for all six, which is what the actor has always done. A family you do not select reports null on every one of its fields, never false, and is not counted in program_count.

ats_slug.title: ATS slug override
ats_slug.description: Skip ATS discovery and read this Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby board slug directly.

scan_job_postings.title: Scan job postings
scan_job_postings.description: Reads the company's live job bodies from its ATS. This path finds benefits language that marketing pages omit.

scan_web_pages.title: Scan website pages
scan_web_pages.description: Probes the careers, culture, benefits, DEI and ESG paths. This path finds ERG and volunteering language that job postings omit.

max_pages.title: Max pages to fetch
max_pages.description: Sent as a string for Clay. Clamped to 1 to 25.

skipCache.title: Skip cache
skipCache.description: false uses the 14 day cache, true forces a fresh crawl. Sent as a string for Clay, matching the fleet convention.

source_tag.title: Source Tag
source_tag.description: Internal attribution tag set by Mamba Labs on published task examples. Not required, and nothing depends on it. Leave it empty.
